However, it is possible to interpolate distance to three decimal places. There are tick marks to indicate the second decimal place number centered on the display as well as increments of +0.0025, +0.0050, and +0.0075. When touched, the Control button will pause the two odometers for 4 seconds to allow you time to estimate distance to thousandths.

Similarly, time measurements are limited to whole seconds or cents. Time, distance, and mode (discussed below) may be chosen at the start of a new rally by touching the Set button to access app Settings.

A set of buttons allows you to chose the active odometer. The leftmost button activates the lower "interval distance" odometer; the rightmost button activates the upper "total distance" odometer; the center button activates both odometers.

From time to time you may measure time and distance for a stage or a checkpoint and record data by touching the Control button. The time and distance will be stored in a log along with geographic coordinates.

Distance options include subtraction of distance when you travel off course. Direction buttons switch between forward (+), reverse (–), and park (0). Also, you may chose between miles or kilometers.

There are three modes of operation selectable in the app Settings: Regularity mode, Jogularity mode, and Lap mode. In Regularity mode, the stopwatch will be reset to zero each time the Control button is pressed. In Jogularity mode the time split will be recorded but the stopwatch will continue recording. In Lap mode, the tabular display will reset the stopwatch to zero when the control button relabeled Lap Reset is touched and each split time will be identified as a Lap in the table. But often you can’t remember all the crucial details then. Likewise handwritten catch logs also require time-consuming evaluation at the end of the year.

Especially designed for fishing, this catch log app allows you to save all important information about your catches and bites on your smartphone. Many parameters can be entered via one tap only without having to write a lot. In addition you can add pictures of your caught fishes to every input.

On the basis of water, spot, date and time, water level, weather, wind force, lunar phase, air temperature, water temperature, wind direction, air pressure, species, weight, rig, bait or any other remarks you can analyze your catch success and make the right conclusions when it’s time to be at the water.

On the basis of the graphical evaluation you can see the trend at a glance, which conditions are highly promising. These statistics you can watch for your overall data, for a special water only, or even for a special spot. An intelligent search helps to find catches which are already long way back in time.

Soccer team management at your fingertips.

Soccer Teammate is a soccer team management application for youth soccer coaches. It is easy and fun to use, whilst being a powerful productivity tool for anyone involved in coaching youth soccer at any age or level.

Record key game events in real-time. These include goals, assists, shots (on and off target), saves, crosses, corner kicks, substitutions, fouls, offsides, penalty goals and misses, yellow and red cards, own goals. Playing position and formation changes can also be recorded.

Track playing time for each player and statistics for all events during a game. Overall and individual player statistics, including playing time, can be viewed and filtered by team, competition, season and opponent. Team records can be viewed for all games and similarly filtered.

Directly manipulate team line-ups and formations for maximum flexibility and ease of use. For example, during an 11-a-side game, 4-4-2 can quickly be changed to 4-3-3 simply by dragging a player from midfield to attack or alternatively to 4-5-1 by dragging a player from attack to midfield. Substitutions can be made by dragging players to and from the bench.

Define multiple competitions, each with their own game format, including the number of players and substitutes, the number of periods and their duration and whether they can go to overtime and/or a penalty shootout if the score is level. This can be overridden for individual games.

Record contact information for all players and coaches for easier communication with parents and opposing team coaches.  Link games to calendar events and their location to maps.

Share information by email, SMS, Facebook and Twitter and automatically tweet game events.

Define jersey colors and styles and team logos for all teams making team identification easy. Use numbered player jerseys or photos to identify players within team line-ups.

We are committed to supporting and enhancing Soccer Teammate with the aim of making it the number one choice for youth soccer coaches everywhere.

If you encounter any problems using Soccer Teammate or have any questions or suggestions, please report them at http://www.acesportsapps.com/support.htm
